reviews.author: Mike Martin
reviews.text: 100% Recommend Coastline. I'm a pretty particular guy, and these men and women have maintained absolutely the most professional attitude and first-class service despite me. I'm grateful for their graciousness and will be a customer for life. Greg is a killer and knows his business about boats. Check them out, you'll be happy you did!

reviews.author: Mark Garza
reviews.text: Great buying experience and customer support. Greg and Sarah were amazing to work with and went above and beyond.

reviews.author: Jeff Terrell
reviews.text: Purchased a new boat from Greg Walker. He is very knowledgeable and was great to work with.

groups.title: Service and Rigging
groups.summary: Boat and outboard service from certified Yamaha, Suzuki, Evinrude and Mercury techs, plus rigging and mobile service.
groups.intro: Our highly trained technicians maintain and service your boat and outboard so you can get the most out of your purchase. We are boating enthusiasts and we know your priority is getting out on the water, so we aim to get you in and out of the shop efficiently, whether your goal is fishing, cruising or tow sports.

groups.title: Parts and Electronics
groups.summary: A wide selection of parts and accessories; if it is not in stock, we will order it.
groups.intro: Whether you need repairs or maintenance, or want to customize your boat, our parts staff can help you find the right parts and accessories. We are an authorized dealer for Power Pole, JL Audio, Wet Sounds, Garmin, Lowrance, Minn Kota, Simrad and Plash Lights, among others. Call (281) 291-0101, come in, or send a parts request.

groups.title: Boat Sales
groups.summary: New and pre-owned boats from Shallow Sport, SCB, Hewes, Maverick, Sea Hunt and Monterey, with financing options.
groups.intro: We are the exclusive Houston-area dealer for Shallow Sport Boats, SCB Boats, Hewes and Maverick, and the South Houston dealer for Sea Hunt Boats. Monterey boats are also on our lineup. Financing and pricing options are available, and you can apply for financing, ask for a quote, value your trade or schedule a viewing.

groups.title: Sell Us Your Boat
groups.summary: Sell your boat to us outright, or let us sell it for you. Contact us for a free appraisal.
groups.intro: Whether you want us to sell your boat for you or sell it to us outright, we are here to make the process simple, painless and worry-free. Tell us about your boat or yacht and one of our trained staff will get in touch with you. We buy hundreds of boats a year from individuals, businesses, banks and even other dealers.

services.title: We Will Buy Your Boat
services.text: We offer fair market value for your boat, handle all payoff paperwork and make the purchase outright. With our boating knowledge, mechanical expertise and high volume purchasing, we are your ideal buyer.

services.title: Let Us Sell Your Boat
services.text: From attracting buyers all the way through the sale and closing, we have you covered. We agree on a net dollar amount you will receive for your boat when it sells.
points: No need for expensive classified advertising
No strangers knocking at your door
No late night phone calls, texts or annoying emails

services.title: Free Appraisal
services.text: Fill out our form with your boat's year, make, model, condition and engine details, and one of our trained staff will get in touch with you.

about.title: Boating enthusiasts, open since 2008
text: Coastline Marine was founded in 2008 with a simple goal: provide the highest quality products and craftsmanship while maintaining superior customer satisfaction.
We are boating enthusiasts, and we know your priority is getting out on the water. Our new service center, our certified techs and our custom aluminum shop are all built around that.
We also buy hundreds of boats a year from individuals, businesses, banks and other dealers.

facts.heading: Win Your Boat
facts.text: Purchase any new or pre-owned boat and get one swing on the Full Swing golf simulator. Hole in one: win your boat for free. Inside 3 feet: win 10,000 dollars cash. Inside 10 feet: win a Power Pole. On the green: first outboard service free.

facts.heading: Online Orders
items: Orders are accepted through the secure online order form; most major credit cards are accepted.
Shipped by UPS Ground or US Postal Service in the continental US; allow 4 to 10 business days.
Returns must be postmarked within 30 days, in new condition, preauthorized, and are subject to a 15% restocking fee.
Incorrect items are replaced and we pay the additional shipping.
